source.text: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, you can select one friendly **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit that is **Battle-shocked** and within 12" of this unit’s **DARK APOSTLE** model. That unit is no longer Battle-shocked.

If your Army Faction is **HERETIC ASTARTES**, each time a unit with this ability is selected to shoot or fight, it can make a Dark Pact. If it does, it must first take a **Leadership test** before any effects of that Dark Pact are resolved; if that test is failed, that unit suffers D3 **mortal wounds**. Then, select one of the following abilities for that unit’s weapons to gain until the end of the phase:
- **[LETHAL HITS]**
- **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]**
*Wahapedia FAQ: Can I select a unit to shoot when there are no eligible targets so that unit can make a Dark Pact? No.*
*Wahapedia FAQ: When I select a unit as the target of the Fire Overwatch Stratagem, can that unit make a Dark Pact? Yes, as the unit is selected to shoot.*
